name: uno-party
description: Real-time multiplayer UNO-style card game for 2–8 friends

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.e2e: VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm --prefix client run build && sh e2e/services.sh start && python3 e2e/run_e2e.py; sh e2e/services.sh stop
scripts.audit:layout: VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm --prefix client run build && sh e2e/services.sh start && python3 e2e/layout_audit.py; sh e2e/services.sh stop
